title: Intraday DCA run classification block (11:30 AM / 1:30 PM / 2:30 PM ET live execution)
description: The run_classification object embedded in every INTRADAY run_state artifact. The intraday stream is the recurring live task 7be82b97, firing at three ET slots (11:30, 13:30, 14:30) with run_type='intraday_dca_live', trades=true, on account 562057042, using the same $2-base 0x-to-5x sizing ladder as the morning/midday/afternoon live streams. Each run passes its actual fire time via scheduled_for_et (see config/scheduled_tasks.json:multi_slot_task_note); this schema pins the window/run_id shape per slot. Distinct from the ad hoc one-off intraday SCHEDULED-RECOVERY runs (e.g. the 2026-07-24 intraday_1430 recovery), which use a stream value starting with 'intraday' but are not this recurring task and are not validated against this schema. It is INDEPENDENT of the afternoon live task 10ce362c (which supersedes ce16ba6b): stream='intraday' and valid_afternoon_evidence=false always, so afternoon slippage/watchdog/weekly reporting never treats an intraday artifact as afternoon scheduled evidence. Intraday scheduled fills count only as prior-allocation context for the midday and afternoon same-day top-up guards (Codex review: "Include the 11:30 intraday run in midday context"). Contains no secrets.

run_origin.description: Origin of the intraday run. 'scheduled' is one of the 11:30/13:30/14:30 ET live executions; everything else is 'manual'.

run_type.description: 'intraday_dca_live' for the 11:30/13:30/14:30 ET live executions. Deliberately never the afternoon 'scheduled_live_test' or any morning/midday/market-open run_type.

stream.description: Stream marker for the recurring intraday live task. Always exactly 'intraday' (not a slot-suffixed variant like the ad hoc 'intraday_1430' recovery stream, which this schema does not cover) so this artifact is never confused with the morning, midday, market-open, or afternoon stream.

trades.description: Always true: the intraday stream is a live Robinhood execution.

manual_run.description: true for manual intraday runs, false for scheduled intraday runs. Must agree with run_origin.

cron_id.description: Intraday task id: '7be82b97' for all three 11:30/13:30/14:30 ET live executions. Distinct from the morning ('42173154'), midday ('a6239dae'), market-open ('2ba19526'), and afternoon ('10ce362c') live tasks.

supersedes_cron_id.description: Always null: the intraday task supersedes nothing.

scheduled_for_et.description: Nominal ET fire time, HH:MM. One of '11:30', '13:30', or '14:30' for scheduled runs (see config/scheduled_tasks.json:multi_slot_task_note); null for manual runs.

scheduled_window_start_et.description: Inclusive start of the accepted intraday window for the fired slot, in ET, HH:MM.

scheduled_window_end_et.description: Inclusive end of the accepted intraday window for the fired slot, in ET, HH:MM.

run_id.description: Unique run id. Scheduled: 'intraday_live_YYYYMMDD_(1130|1330|1430)ET' matching the fired slot. Manual: 'manual_intraday_live_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSSZ_<suffix>'.

triggered_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run was triggered.

state_schema_version.description: Contract version tag: 'intraday-live-v1' for the live execution.

valid_afternoon_evidence.description: Always false. An intraday artifact is NEVER valid afternoon scheduled-live evidence; it counts only as prior-allocation context for the midday/afternoon same-day top-up guards.

afternoon_live_cron_id.description: The afternoon live task id ('10ce362c') recorded for cross-reference only.

allOf.comment: Live execution (any of the three ET slots) invariants.
Scheduled 11:30 AM ET slot: pinned window and run_id pattern.
Scheduled 1:30 PM ET slot: pinned window and run_id pattern.
Scheduled 2:30 PM ET slot: pinned window and run_id pattern.
Manual runs never use a scheduled run_id and are always manual_run=true.
